button.label: Run UAP
button.supertip: Run the UAP optimization solver on the current workbook. Reads affordable units with AMI values and finds optimal band assignments.

button.label: Run MIH
button.supertip: Run the MIH optimization solver on the current workbook. Uses MIH!J21 as the residential SF denominator and applies Option 1/Option 4 rules.

button.label: View Scenarios
button.supertip: View and apply different optimization scenarios from the last solver run.

dynamicMenu.label: AMI Bands
dynamicMenu.supertip: Choose which AMI bands the optimizer may use for THIS workbook (e.g. uncheck 60%). The list adapts to the program and MIH option; 40% stays on where the program requires it. Saved inside the workbook.

toggleButton.label: Spread Across Floors
toggleButton.supertip: HPD reviewer test: the 40% AMI apartments must include at least one on the lower, middle and upper floors of the affordable pool. Rent is not affected by floors. ON by default for MIH workbooks. If no option can satisfy it, results say so and are shown without it. Saved inside the workbook.

dynamicMenu.label: 40% Rules
dynamicMenu.supertip: Optional: decide yourself which affordable apartments carry the 40% label (only rows with an AMI value count; blank AMI = market rate). Select unit rows on the sheet, then pin them at 40% or keep them out; limit 40% to certain bedroom types or floors; cap 40% units per floor. The optimizer still finds the best rent within your rules. 'Clear all 40% rules' lets the program decide again. Saved inside the workbook.

dropDown.label: Rent Roll Year
dropDown.supertip: Select which rent calculator year to use for MIH/UAP calculations (default 2025).

button.label: Refresh Rent Tables (Selected Year)
button.supertip: Rebuild the local per-user rent tables cache (CSV) for the selected year from the authoritative year workbook (Z:\\ first; %APPDATA% fallback).

button.label: Rent Tables Status
button.supertip: Show Rent Tables status on the Diagnostics sheet (selected year, cache source file, timestamps).

button.label: Verify Manual Rents (API)
button.supertip: One-click verification: compare locally-computed Manual Working Copy rents to /api/evaluate for the selected year. Shows a single summary and writes details to Diagnostics.

button.label: Manage Rent Roll Years...
button.supertip: Upload/replace the rent calculator for the selected year and activate it on the API.

dropDown.label: Select Rent Roll
dropDown.supertip: Select which rent roll sheet to use for optimization.

button.label: Refresh List
button.supertip: Refresh the list of available rent roll sheets.

button.label: Utilities
button.supertip: Configure utility payment settings (electricity, gas, heat, hot water).

button.label: API Settings
button.supertip: Configure API connection settings and authentication.

button.label: Record Choice
button.supertip: Record which scenario the client chose (no API call). Appends to the shared run log file in the log folder.

button.label: Log Settings
button.supertip: Configure the log folder location (e.g. Z:\\AMI_Optix_Learning).

button.label: Manual Calculate
button.supertip: Compute Scenario Manual results from the current AMI inputs (even if non-compliant).

button.label: Diagnostics
button.supertip: Create a Diagnostics sheet with the current log path, whether the run log file exists, and the last API scenario counts/keys/notes.
